# Refusal codes

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-refusal-codes.py; do not edit by hand -->

Every `EngineError` the auction engine can refuse with. The wire code is `6000 + engine code`; a failed transaction reads `Program error [6001]: Program error 1: NotAdmin`. The v0.2.4 programs and the 0.4 engine share this enum (through `crates/auction_engine_params`), so one catalogue covers both. Codes 6070 and up are the 0.4 engine's `RiskError` (`v04/risk_core`), wrapped with `EngineError` in `engine_core::check::Refusal`. `Proved by` lists the tests whose body names the variant or its wire form.
